newsitem.title: FRANCE: Tietmeyer-Dlr rate vs Euro forex realistic now.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-Dlr rate vs Euro forex realistic now.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said the foreign exchange rates of many European currencies against the dollar was more realistic now and said he was pleased that the United States continued to voice support for a strong dollar, daily Le Monde reported on Wednesday.

"I think that the current rate of many European currencies against the dollar is much more realistic than a little time ago and I am pleased to take note that U.S. officials clearly say they continue to be interested in a strong dollar," Tietmeyer said in an interview.
Tietmeyer also said he was happy with the current rate of the mark within the European Monetary System (EMS).
"I have no problems with the current rate of the mark within the EMS, which is, basically, correct," he said.
He added that he wanted a "strong and stable" single European currency when it was launched.
